basic.location: Bloomingdale, Illinois, United States | Chicago Metro | Remote | Hybrid
basic.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping production systems across aviation, supply chain, and banking domains. Proven success delivering customer-facing generative AI products, internal AI platforms, real-time distributed systems, and enterprise logistics and core-banking software. Hands-on expertise spans LLMs and RAG, applied ML for document understanding, event-driven microservices, full-stack web platforms, and legacy-system modernization using Python, C#, TypeScript, PyTorch, and AWS. Experienced translating ambiguous business requirements into reliable, observable, production-grade platforms operating under regulatory and safety constraints (FAA, GxP / 21 CFR Part 11, DOT, financial-services compliance). Passionate about applying modern AI and strong engineering fundamentals to solve real-world problems with measurable user and business impact.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built customer-facing disruption-messaging LLM generating personalized delay and cancellation notifications grounded in live operational data (weather, crew, maintenance, ATC), delivering +6% CSAT and 100K+ production notifications across app push, SMS, email, and gate-display channels.

Designed guardrail, grounding, and evaluation frameworks for customer-facing generative AI, enforcing legal and compliance constraints (DOT 240 tarmac rules, ADA requirements) and mitigating hallucinations on regulated passenger communications.

Contributed to United's internal GenAI platform on Amazon Bedrock, building multi-model routing across Claude, Titan, and Llama, shared RAG infrastructure, and evaluation harnesses consumed by multiple product teams across the airline.

Implemented multi-tenant governance, PII redaction, audit logging, and cost-attribution services for the internal AI platform, supporting secure generative-AI adoption across engineering and non-engineering functions.

Extended real-time flight hold-decision services balancing FAA 117 crew duty limits, fuel, downstream connection cascades, and outbound load factors over event-driven ingest from flight-ops, crew, and location streams.

Rebuilt passenger notification pipelines delivering personalized SMS with walking directions, gate reassignments, and ETA updates, saving thousands of connections per month across hub-to-hub itineraries.
Built RAG retrieval services, embedding pipelines, and evaluation tooling in Python and PyTorch backing production LLM features at airline scale.
Deployed real-time inference and orchestration services on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, EKS, Kong API Gateway) with autoscaling, model versioning, and observability for live customer traffic.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built ML-powered document extraction and HS-code classification pipelines processing customs brokerage paperwork (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin) across 10,000+ hierarchical tariff codes and multiple shipper languages and formats.

Developed human-in-the-loop review workflows where broker corrections fed back into the classification model, reducing manual data-entry hours per shipment and cutting customs-hold rates driven by misclassification.

Shipped real-time temperature-excursion alerting for UPS Healthcare cold-chain and clinical-trial logistics, ingesting IoT telemetry from thousands of probes per shipment with drug-specific stability budgets and sub-minute escalation SLAs.

Built immutable chain-of-custody auditing systems for GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 regulatory inspection, supporting UPS Healthcare's COVID vaccine distribution and decentralized clinical-trial site-to-patient workflows.

Delivered the quote-comparison and booking experience for UPS Forwarding Hub, aggregating real-time air and ocean freight rates across multi-leg routings and moving a material portion of SCS bookings from phone/email (days) to self-service (minutes).

Built full-stack features across Flex Global View and Forwarding Hub platforms — .NET / C# backend microservices for alerting, reporting, and booking, with Angular / TypeScript front-ends used by enterprise logistics customers.
Integrated Supply Chain Symphony APIs federating warehouse management, transportation management, and freight-visibility data into a unified portal view for enterprise and healthcare customers.
Designed ETL and streaming pipelines over SQL Server and Oracle for shipment tracking, exception alerting, and analytics supporting air, ocean, ground, customs, and warehousing operations.

Developed modern REST API layers over the FLEXCUBE core exposing balance inquiry, funds transfer, bill payment, and statement generation to web, mobile, USSD, and ATM channels.

Built authentication, session, and idempotency layers for money-movement APIs, managing caching and eventual-consistency trade-offs between public digital channels and the slower core system of record.

Built custom ETL jobs and operational reports for Oracle ERP deployments at Nigerian enterprise clients.
